title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Split-Flap Concourse. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Time entries as departures: cascading updates, live status rows, the whole concourse watching the same board.
options.viewport: A full-width departure board showing today's time entries as live rows, hours cascading into place character by character.
options.risk: Reads retro-novelty when the animation is gratuitous rather than functional.

raised.raise: Sticky positioned status bands persist during scroll.
Detail views hinge open with lid-reveal interaction.
Time periods organized as horizon bands (today, this week, this month).
Strict monospace grid discipline for all tabular data.

options.label: Accountant's Ledger
options.thesis: The ruled ledger that accountants trust: green rules, red/black ink, running totals in the margin.
options.viewport: A ruled columnar page with time entries in careful rows, hours summed in the margin, today's work in fresh ink.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: Airport Wayfinding
options.thesis: Yellow wayfinding bands guide you through the work: gates become clients, distances become hours.
options.viewport: Overhead yellow bands showing client routes, time remaining to invoice due dates.
options.case: Wins on clarity (excellent state communication) but loses on identification (airports aren't the freelancer's world).
options.risk: The industrial wayfinding aesthetic may feel too impersonal for solo work.

options.label: Yéyé Pop Sleeve
options.case: Time tracking needs structure, not pop energy. Loses both axes.
options.kept: Courage of one flat saturated ground per surface state.

options.label: Sneaker Archive
options.case: Box-stack metaphor doesn't serve professional billing. Loses both axes.
options.kept: Lid-hinge reveal interaction for detail expansion.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.case: Theatrical atmosphere doesn't serve data-dense time tracking. Loses both axes.

options.label: ASCII Live Render
options.case: Terminal nostalgia is cosplay for modern billing software. Loses both axes.
options.kept: Strict monospace grid integrity for tabular data.

canonCard.label: Standard SaaS Dashboard
canonCard.thesis: The familiar pattern: sidebar nav, card metrics, data tables, neutral palette.
canonCard.viewport: A dashboard with metric cards at top, filterable data table below, sidebar navigation.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other tool in the category.

reroll.steer: Optional: describe what quality is missing
